_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE upper-arm muscle volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_arm_muscles_from_cryo.py: the male's compartment and naming rules on her registered cryosection photographs around her TotalSegmentator humerus label), plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Rule-based: anterior/posterior by the coronal plane through the humerus; brachialis within 22 mm of the humerus in the distal 65 %; coracobrachialis proximal, medial, within 15 mm; biceps the rest anterior; triceps the whole posterior compartment. Boundaries are rules, not traced fascia; badge it.
Female colour classes (scripts/cryo/cryo_classes_f.py, 2026-09-12): her frozen muscle is darker and browner than the male's; the male's class missed 40-60 % of it.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female cryosections and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 humerus label as anchor.

biceps_right.note: superficial anterior compartment; boundary with brachialis rule-based

brachialis_right.note: anterior compartment within 22 mm of the humerus, distal 65 %

coracobrachialis_right.note: The proximal-medial rule finds under 1 cm3 on her (2026-09-12); not shipped.

triceps_right.note: whole posterior compartment; three heads not separated
